params.caption: 🏆 MOUZ survive a scare against FUT at BLAST in Hong Kong MOUZ were one step from last-place elimination after dropping the first map to FUT and falling 6-12 behind on Mirage. xertioN and his teammates fought back to win the series and stay alive in the Hong Kong event. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 13:35 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV 🔥 React if you love a comeback · 💬 How far can MOUZ go from here? #CS2 #MOUZ #GamingNews
